# langsmith_chart_preview (Data Source)

Computes preview data points for a hypothetical workspace-scoped chart via `POST /api/v1/charts/preview` without persisting it. Returns the raw data point series as JSON. Workspace-scoped previews require each series to include a `filters.session` array (project IDs) — the API rejects requests without one with a 422. **Note:** the result depends on the current state of LangSmith data, so consecutive plans may return different values; this data source is intended for inspection/debugging rather than long-lived Terraform state.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "langsmith_chart_preview" "example" {
  start_time = "2026-01-01T00:00:00Z"
  end_time   = "2026-01-02T00:00:00Z"
  stride     = jsonencode({ hours = 1 })

  series = jsonencode([
    {
      # Each preview series requires an id (any UUID — it has no persistence).
      id     = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001"
      name   = "Run Count"
      metric = "run_count"

      # Workspace-scoped previews require a `session` (project) filter on each
      # series, otherwise the API returns 422.
      filters = {
        session = [data.langsmith_project.example.id]
      }
    }
  ])
}

output "preview_data" {
  value = jsondecode(data.langsmith_chart_preview.example.data)
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `series` (String) JSON-encoded array of chart series configurations. **Each series must include an `id`** (any UUID — preview series IDs have no persistence; the API requires the field for request validation).

### Optional

- `common_filters` (String) JSON-encoded common filter configuration applied to all series.
- `end_time` (String) RFC3339 end timestamp for the preview window.
- `start_time` (String) RFC3339 start timestamp for the preview window.
- `stride` (String) JSON-encoded `TimedeltaInput` for bucket width (e.g. `jsonencode({minutes = 15})`). Defaults to 15 minutes server-side.
- `timezone` (String) IANA timezone for bucket alignment. Defaults to `UTC` server-side.

### Read-Only

- `data` (String) JSON-encoded array of preview data points, each shaped as `{series_id, timestamp, value, group}`.
